entries.msgid: A holder chooses records to share
Build and sign the ITI-YY5 manifest request

Build the ITI-YY5 request: POST <url>/List/_search with the form body (passcode only when the P flag is set), its Content-Digest and its RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signature. The host sends it over mutual TLS.

candidates.text: بناء طلب ITI-YY5: POST <url>/List/_ بحث مع جسم الشكل (رمز المرور فقط عند تعيين العلم P)، و Content-Digest و RFC 9421 HTTP رسالة التوقيع. المضيف يرسله على TLS المتبادل.
